runtime_proof.note: Measured read-only against production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm. No row was written, updated or deleted; no containment setting, kill switch or delivery target was touched. These are the exact populations the repaired surfaces render.

queries.name: CLV is absent on every settled pick in the governed cohort
queries.method: read-only SELECT over picks LEFT JOIN settlement_records WHERE picks.metadata ? 'distributionMode', counting settlement rows whose payload->>'clvPercent' is null
queries.result: 7 governed picks, 6 settlement rows, 6 with clvPercent null, 0 with a value, 0 carrying isOpeningLineFallback
queries.significance: This is why the rendering matters. Every CLV cell an operator sees today is an absence, and the old bare dash made 'no closing line was ever captured' indistinguishable from 'this column does not apply'. The repaired renderer names the reason instead. It manufactures no value: CLV stays null and stays deferred until the provider decision resolves.

queries.name: the held queue is structurally excluded from the review queue
queries.method: read-only SELECT over picks_current_state WHERE status = 'awaiting_approval' OR approval_status = 'pending', partitioned on review_decision = 'hold' — the exact predicates getHeldQueue and getReviewQueue apply
queries.result: 21,871 rows in approval scope; 2,075 with review_decision = 'hold'; 19,796 without
queries.significance: The previous /held redirect sent an operator to a surface whose own filter excludes all 2,075 held rows. The count is not theoretical, and the redirect repair is what makes those rows reachable.

observations.what: the repair is presentational; the underlying data is unchanged
observations.evidence: 0 rows written, updated or deleted. Every file in the diff is under apps/command-center, which reads Supabase directly and writes only through apps/api.

observations.what: provider-dependent capability is deferred, not faked
